hooks.prompt: Run the Vitest test suite with: npx vitest run (if npx is not on PATH, source .claude/hooks/env.local.sh first when it exists). If any tests fail, analyze the failures, fix the issues, and re-run until all tests pass. Do not stop until the test suite is green. Context: $ARGUMENTS

Review the sub-agent's test results. Check: 1) Did every new or changed test run and pass under Vitest? 2) Were any tests skipped (.skip/.todo) or focused (.only) without explanation? 3) Did all assertions use expect() statements, and did tests query the DOM with Testing Library role/text queries instead of raw CSS selectors? If any check fails, report the issues. Context: $ARGUMENTS
